mission: Two editorial fixes: (1) correct the refuted Con Ed TOU rates on page 46, (2) give the homepage a keyword-bearing title tag.
context:
Repo path has a space — quote it.
(1) content/blog/46-what-time-is-electricity-cheapest.md — verified facts (wave-2 verifier, fetched 2026-08-29, CON ED LIVE PAGE coned.com/en/accounts-billing/your-bill/time-of-use): summer peak Jun 1–Sep 30, 8am–midnight $0.2786/kWh; other-months peak $0.1711/kWh; off-peak (all other hours incl. weekends) $0.0522/kWh; delivery 8am–midnight $0.16402/kWh (>250 kWh summer tier $0.18858); monthly customer charge $21.00. The article's WRONG figures: 22.33c/44.97c (lines ~37, 46) and the 'roughly 50% off-peak discount' claim (line ~56 — real discount is ~81% vs summer peak, ~70% vs winter peak). The article's hour/period definitions are CORRECT — keep them. Rewrite the affected passages so every number matches the verified set, update the front-matter sources entry for Con Ed with '(retrieved 2026-08-29)', and update front-matter 'updated: 2026-08-30'. Keep the page's existing structure/tone; do not pad. Also scan the page for any OTHER Con Ed-dependent numbers and fix consistently.
(2) layouts/partials/head.html line 34: '{{ if .IsHome }}{{ .Site.Title }}{{ else }}...' renders bare 'Utility Explained'. Change ONLY the .IsHome branch to a keyword title, total ≤60 chars, e.g. 'Utility Explained: Read & Lower Your Utility Bills' (you may refine wording, keep the length cap and no trailing '| Utility Explained' duplication on home). Do not touch the else branch.

success_criteria: Page 46: zero occurrences of 22.33/44.97/50%-discount; all Con Ed figures match the verified set; sources front matter dated
